versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g 27 of 53 Document ID 1018: AUTOSAR_SWS_MemoryDriver Specification of Memory Driver AUTOSAR CP R21-11 Service Name Mem_DeInit (draft) Syntax void Mem_DeInit ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x0b Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description De-initialize module. If there is still an access job pending, it is immediately terminated (using hardware cancel operation) and the Mem driver module state is set to unitialized. Therefore, Mem must be re-initialized before it will accept any new job requests after this service is processed. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Mem.h
